result: SUBSTANTIVE_REASONING_CORROBORATED; CONDITIONAL CONFIGURATION QUESTION REMAINS; NO NEW CONFIRMED DEFECT

evidence.identity: Current source raw SHA, source-symbol index hash, stable ID and 36-40 span match the handoff and receipt; receipt itself matches the handoff SHA and exact symbol span.
evidence.arithmetic: Source is piecewise: late<=grace returns 0; otherwise <=60 returns min(1,maxPenaltyHours); >60 returns maxPenaltyHours. Return unit is penalty-hours and no proportional minutes calculation occurs. Negative max can return negative hours; grace>=60 alters threshold reachability.
evidence.call_chain: CalculateLateDeduction multiplies rate by returned hours and configured multiplier. Biometric check-in floors elapsed late minutes to >=0 and posts only positive penalty amounts using deterministic employee/date ID. CorrectAttendance recalculates old/new deductions under employee-ledger update lock and writes the signed delta as Adjustment. Payroll loads period ledger facts. Settings handler assigns nullable grace/max/multiplier values without local range checks in the inspected block, but requires settings_manage elsewhere; default settings are ordinary positive values.
evidence.tests: PayrollRulesTests covers ordinary grace and 60/61 minute tiers and positive-config amount calculation, not negative max/grace or correction-delta behavior. Server integration sources did not test this edge. Test sources were inspected but not run.

counterevidence_and_limits: No owner-approved invariant defining allowable grace/max/multiplier ranges was found in the reviewed source material.

Negative settings reachability is suggested by an authorized settings API assignment without local range validation, but was not dynamically reproduced; caller/UI/API perimeter and configuration ownership remain to be separately examined.
Biometric auto-post suppresses non-positive amount. Correction path is signed and may have different consequences if malformed settings are stored.
No database/runtime/financial operation or test execution.
disposition: Promote only this callable to SUBSTANTIVE_REVIEW_VERIFIED in the evidence overlay. Preserve malformed settings/correction delta as a conditional follow-up and do not create a duplicate FIN finding absent policy/behavior proof.
next_action: Financial continuation agent to review UpdateSettingsHandler.HandleAsync/request/API paths and tests specifically for payroll policy range validation and correction consequences; coordinator will verify that handoff and avoid re-reviewing the pure arithmetic callable.
